'''Mike Emery The Yoda Echo Base Operations Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Emery]]
* '''Published:''' June 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' The Yoda Echo Base Operations Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag The Yoda Echo Base Operations Deck.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I like to use this deck to Force Drain my opponent to death at some systems, meanwhile thinning out their armada with Collision and carefully-timed attacks.

== Strategy ==

With this deck, I suggest setting up Echo Base Operations as soon as possible. Then deploy Dagobah, using its game text to deploy Yoda's Hut. Deploy Yoda and give him Yoda's Gimer Stick. Move him around and attack the Dark Side where you have Yoda. When Echo Base Operations is in place, try to get a starfighter alone at the Death Star immediately for a Force Drain of FIVE!

Enjoy playing this deck, and enjoy winning every game you play.
